newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan government's assessment of economy unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Japan government's assessment of economy unchanged.

text.p: Japan's government kept its assessment of the nation's economy unchanged on Tuesday, saying it was continuing on a path of gradual recovery.
The phraseology of the Economic Planning Agency's (EPA) monthly economic report for December, which is closely watched by markets for signs of policy shift, was unchanged from November.
"Our country's economy continues to recover, although the pace of the recovery is slow," the report said.

But as a sign of the government's increasing optimism, the report said industrial production was increasing, moving a step forward from the previous month, when the EPA said output was "gradually" increasing.
The report also said exports remained strong, due to a rise in exports of electrical equipment to Asian nations and of car parts.
For most of this year, the EPA has described Japan's economy as gradually recovering, despite some weakness after years of negligible growth.
